A cotton-candy cart — pink-canopied brick cart, spun-sugar drum, rack of pink-and-blue cotton-candy builds, vendor handing one to a reaching toddler minifig.
A popcorn stand — red-and-white striped brick stand, trans-yellow round-plate kernels overflowing the kettle-build, a trail of spilled pieces leading to a guilty minifig.
A hot-dog cart — yellow-canopied brick cart, a row of hot-dog-builds under a hinged-plate lid, vendor minifig squeezing a ketchup-red bar over a waiting customer's order.
A balloon vendor — minifig gripping a fat cluster of round balloon-elements on bar-strings, one escaped skyward, a small kid pointing up, mouth open wide.
A ticket booth — ornate brick kiosk, printed-tile price-board, roll-of-tickets element on the counter, a three-minifig queue shuffling forward, the front one coins-in-hand.
A ring-toss stall — brick game-counter, peg-board of bottle-builds, basket of bright-brick rings, row of prize-plush-builds overhead, vendor mid-coaxing-gesture at a reluctant passerby.
A duck-pond game — brick trough, trans-blue channel, yellow duck-builds circling slowly, a kid minifig lifting one triumphantly, numbered prize-tile flipped over beneath it.
A shooting-gallery — brick-walled booth, hinged tin-plate target-builds on a rail, a minifig aiming a bar-piece rifle, attendant already reaching for a second-row target.
A prize-wall — back-wall brick stall hung with rows of plush-builds in bear and star shapes, a winning kid stretching up as the vendor unpegs the biggest bear.
A mascot character — large brick-built smiling star figure towering above the midway, arm raised for a high-five, three delighted kid minifigs leaping to reach it.
A churro stand — brick cart with fryer-build, stack of golden bar-piece churros dusted in white-round-plate sugar, a four-minifig queue already has napkins ready.
A souvenir kiosk — brick kiosk hung with pennant-tiles, hat-elements on peg-bars, mini-build trinkets on a shelf, a minifig trying on an oversized comedy-hat, grinning sideways.
A bench with resting minifigs — brick park-bench under a string-light arch, two tired minifigs clutching snack-builds and balloon-strings, a third slumped sideways mid-rest.
A string-light arch — curved brick archway threaded with trans-yellow and trans-orange stud-lights, two minifigs pausing beneath it to pose for a friend holding a camera-tile.
A face-painting stall — small brick booth, paint-palette tile on the counter, kid minifig seated in a chair receiving a printed star design, sample-board propped behind.
A lemonade stand — bright yellow-and-white brick stand, a trans-yellow jug-build, round-plate ice chunks, vendor pouring a cup, a hot and fanning minifig third in line.
A funnel-cake stand — brick cart, deep-fryer build, a golden lattice-plate funnel-cake dusted with white studs, powdered-sugar cloud implied by scattered white round-plates on the counter.
A lost balloon — a single red round-balloon-element drifting upward on a bar-string, no minifig holding it, a tiny handprint-sticker tile left on the brick path below.
A spilled popcorn — a knocked-over trans-yellow round-plate pile scattered across a brick-path section, a sheepish minifig crouching to gather some back, a pigeon-bird-build eyeing the rest.
A photo-cutout board — a flat brick-frame stand with a painted-tile fairground scene and two face-holes, two giggling minifigs pressed against it, a third raising a camera-tile.

A fortune-teller tent — a purple-striped brick tent with a crystal-ball trans-clear dome on the table-tile, a skeptical minifig sitting opposite a dramatically gesturing fortune-teller minifig inside.
A ring-toss winner — a kid minifig clutching a just-claimed small plush-star build, the vendor already resetting bottle-builds on the peg-board, the next player slapping coins down.

A churro-and-lemonade pairing — a minifig balancing a bar-element churro and a trans-yellow cup-build simultaneously, navigating the crowded brick-path without spilling either, expression intensely focused.
A mascot meet-and-greet queue — four minifigs in a brick-railed line, one holding a pennant-tile, another clutching a plush-build for signing, the costumed star-mascot waving from the front.
A midway corner — a brick-built junction where balloon-strings, spilled kernels, and footstep-scuff tiles converge, a lone minifig pausing to check a paper-map tile, entirely overwhelmed.
A shooting gallery — brick back-board with row of hinged target-tiles, a counter with stud-shooter builds; a minifig squinting, one target already knocked flat.
A photo cutout board — flat brick-frame board with two character-shaped holes, painted-tile seaside scene; two laughing minifigs poke their printed faces through, a third minifig photographs them.
A lemonade stand restocking — a minifig ducking behind the pastel brick counter to lift a crate-build of lemon-element refills, a hand-written price-change tile propped against the jug.
A ring-toss prize negotiation — a kid minifig sliding three unclaimed brick rings back across the counter, vendor minifig pointing firmly to the printed-tile rules board mounted on the stall side.

A mascot photo moment — brick-built bear mascot kneeling to match height with a tiny kid minifig, a dad minifig beside them holding a camera-build tile, everyone frozen in a posed grin.
A spilled-popcorn trail — trans-yellow round-plate kernels scattered across the brick-built cobblestone path; a guilty-looking minifig walking quickly away, empty tub-element dangling at its side.
A caricature cart — brick easel-cart with printed-tile sample-portraits on its side; a seated minifig customer, exaggerated-head-element in progress, vendor minifig holding a brush-bar confidently.
A games-prize exchanger — brick counter piled with ticket-stub elements; a minifig trading a tall stack for a tiny plastic-ring prize, expression somewhere between joy and regret.
A street-performer pitch — a circle of minifigs around a brick-built low stage; a juggler minifig mid-act with three bar-element pins aloft, one already clearly heading the wrong direction.
A map-and-information kiosk — brick hexagonal kiosk with a printed-tile park-map panel; a minifig attendant pointing left, a confused family of four all pointing in different directions.
